defmodule CrossAuth.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  Cross-service authentication token verifier.
  Supports dynamic claim validation rules defined by service administrators.
  """

  require Logger

  @hmac_algorithm :sha256
  @token_ttl_seconds 300
  @allowed_transforms ["downcase", "trim", "length", "to_integer", "abs"]

  @doc """
  Returns the list of pre-approved transforms. Used by the ServiceRegistry to
  validate rules at registration time (defense-in-depth).
  """
  def allowed_transforms, do: @allowed_transforms

  defmodule ClaimRule do
    defstruct [:field, :operator, :value, :transform]
  end

  def verify_token(token, service_config) do
    with {:ok, payload} <- decode_and_verify_signature(token, service_config.secret),
         {:ok, claims} <- validate_standard_claims(payload),
         :ok <- validate_custom_rules(claims, service_config.claim_rules) do
      {:ok, claims}
    end
  end

  defp decode_and_verify_signature(token, secret) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [encoded_payload, signature] ->
        expected_sig = :crypto.mac(:hmac, @hmac_algorithm, secret, encoded_payload)
        if secure_compare(signature, Base.url_encode64(expected_sig, padding: false)) do
          case Base.url_decode64(encoded_payload, padding: false) do
            {:ok, json} -> Jason.decode(json)
            _ -> {:error, :invalid_encoding}
          end
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp validate_standard_claims(payload) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    with {:ok, exp} <- Map.fetch(payload, "exp"),
         {:ok, iat} <- Map.fetch(payload, "iat"),
         {:ok, sub} <- Map.fetch(payload, "sub") do
      cond do
        exp < now -> {:error, :token_expired}
        now - iat > @token_ttl_seconds -> {:error, :token_too_old}
        not is_binary(sub) -> {:error, :invalid_subject}
        true -> {:ok, payload}
      end
    else
      :error -> {:error, :missing_required_claims}
    end
  end

  defp validate_custom_rules(claims, rules) when is_list(rules) do
    Enum.reduce_while(rules, :ok, fn rule, :ok ->
      case evaluate_rule(claims, rule) do
        true -> {:cont, :ok}
        false -> {:halt, {:error, {:rule_failed, rule.field}}}
      end
    end)
  end
  defp validate_custom_rules(_claims, _), do: :ok

  defp evaluate_rule(claims, %ClaimRule{} = rule) do
    claim_value = get_nested_claim(claims, rule.field)
    transformed = apply_transform(claim_value, rule.transform)
    compare(transformed, rule.operator, rule.value)
  end

  defp get_nested_claim(claims, field) when is_binary(field) do
    field
    |> String.split(".")
    |> Enum.reduce(claims, fn key, acc ->
      case acc do
        %{} = map -> Map.get(map, key)
        _ -> nil
      end
    end)
  end

  defp apply_transform(value, nil), do: value
  defp apply_transform(value, "downcase") when is_binary(value), do: String.downcase(value)
  defp apply_transform(value, "trim") when is_binary(value), do: String.trim(value)
  defp apply_transform(value, "length") when is_binary(value), do: String.length(value)
  defp apply_transform(value, "to_integer") when is_binary(value) do
    case Integer.parse(value) do
      {int, ""} -> int
      _ -> value
    end
  end
  defp apply_transform(value, "abs") when is_number(value), do: abs(value)
  defp apply_transform(value, transform) when is_binary(transform) do
    # Only allow pre-approved transforms from the allowlist
    if transform in @allowed_transforms do
      Logger.warning("Transform #{transform} matched allowlist but no clause handled it")
      value
    else
      Logger.warning("Rejected unknown transform: #{inspect(transform)}")
      value
    end
  end
  defp apply_transform(value, _), do: value

  defp compare(left, "eq", right), do: left == right
  defp compare(left, "neq", right), do: left != right
  defp compare(left, "in", right) when is_list(right), do: left in right
  defp compare(left, "gt", right) when is_number(left) and is_number(right), do: left > right
  defp compare(left, "lt", right) when is_number(left) and is_number(right), do: left < right
  defp compare(left, "matches", right) when is_binary(left) and is_binary(right) do
    case Regex.compile(right) do
      {:ok, regex} -> Regex.match?(regex, left)
      _ -> false
    end
  end
  defp compare(_, _, _), do: false

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    if byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
      secure_compare_bytes(a, b, 0) == 0
    else
      false
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<x, rest_a::binary>>, <<y, rest_b::binary>>, acc) do
    import Bitwise
    secure_compare_bytes(rest_a, rest_b, acc ||| bxor(x, y))
  end
  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<>>, <<>>, acc), do: acc
end

defmodule CrossAuth.ServiceRegistry do
  @moduledoc """
  Registry for cross-service authentication configurations.
  Service admins can define custom claim validation rules.
  """

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts ++ [name: __MODULE__])
  end

  def register_service(service_id, config) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:register, service_id, config})
  end

  def get_service_config(service_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, service_id})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:register, service_id, config}, _from, state) do
    validated_config = validate_service_config(config)
    {:reply, :ok, Map.put(state, service_id, validated_config)}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, service_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.fetch(state, service_id) do
      {:ok, config} -> {:reply, {:ok, config}, state}
      :error -> {:reply, {:error, :unknown_service}, state}
    end
  end

  defp validate_service_config(config) do
    rules = config
    |> Map.get(:claim_rules, [])
    |> Enum.map(&parse_rule/1)
    |> Enum.filter(&(&1 != nil))

    %{
      secret: Map.fetch!(config, :secret),
      claim_rules: rules,
      service_name: Map.get(config, :service_name, "unknown")
    }
  end

  defp parse_rule(%{field: f, operator: op, value: val} = rule)
       when is_binary(f) and op in ["eq", "neq", "in", "gt", "lt", "matches"] do
    transform = Map.get(rule, :transform)
    validated_transform = if transform in [nil | CrossAuth.TokenVerifier.allowed_transforms()] do
      transform
    else
      nil
    end
    %CrossAuth.TokenVerifier.ClaimRule{
      field: f,
      operator: op,
      value: val,
      transform: validated_transform
    }
  end
  defp parse_rule(_), do: nil
end
